A message handler that appends each frame to a connection

Source: R/helpers_ws.R
ws_file_sink.Rd

Convenience for the recorder hot path: returns a "message" handler that writes each frame followed by a newline to an open connection, doing the absolute minimum so the socket is drained fast (a slow handler can get a connection dropped by the server). Hourly rotation / flushing is the caller's job — pass a connection you flush() and rotate yourself.

Usage

ws_file_sink(con)

Arguments

con

(class<connection>) an open, writable connection (e.g. from base::file() in append mode).

Value

(function) a handler function(message) suitable for StreamClient$on("message", ...).
